intent: Phase 0b: reduce the ref landscape to dev and main, by deletion only, every deleted ref's content already proven contained in dev. Warrant: the operator's consolidation order, an approved-plan warrant, with the per-ref merge proofs in org/plans/2026-08-consolidation.md section 3. Source row WO-0028. The v1 row argued tier T2 rather than T3 because every deletion's content is proven contained, by tree identity or ancestry, and the local reflog retains 90 days. Acceptance, agent half: (1) git branch -D cleanup/consolidation-ux, tip e00b9934, whose tree is byte-identical to dev's #189 squash bef00ba7; (2) git fetch --prune clears the stale origin/feat/benchmarks-trustworthy-fieldkit tracking ref, already deleted on origin, its content landed via the #201 squash 8e989084, and no benchmark code is re-merged because dev deleted that subsystem by design at 4935ac31; (3) the Cursor worktree at C:/Users/Daniel/.cursor/worktrees/hermes-control-hub/flkr needs git worktree repair FIRST, because its gitdir back-pointer targets the pre-rename repository path and git dies inside it, then git -C <path> status --porcelain must come back EMPTY before git worktree remove, --force is forbidden, and if repair fails or the tree is dirty the session stops and hands the operator the listing; (4) then git branch -d cursor/f7b69026, an ancestor of dev; (5) operator ruling D14, 2026-08-22, close the open Dependabot pull requests via gh, whose branches auto-delete; (6) end state verified by git for-each-ref plus git ls-remote --heads origin showing dev and main only, with PR #157 remaining the open dev to main pull request, merging only at the final release per operator ruling D13. Acceptance, operator half, outside any commit: pause or snooze Dependabot in GitHub settings for the programme's duration and re-enable at the final release. Done when the ref landscape is dev, main and nothing unsanctioned. Progress at 2026-08-22: acceptance items 1, 2 and 5 are done, cleanup/consolidation-ux is gone, the stale fieldkit tracking ref is pruned and the open Dependabot pull requests are closed. What remains: the Cursor worktree is dirty, so acceptance item 3's stop rule has fired and the listing goes to the operator; git worktree remove and the follow-on git branch -d cursor/f7b69026 wait on his decision and --force stays forbidden; then acceptance item 6's end-state verification; and the operator half is untouched. Tier proposal R3, matching the declared facts: removing a dirty worktree destroys uncommitted work, which is why the task stops for the operator, and closing pull requests on GitHub is egress beyond the repository.
